{"description":"## Requirements Checklist from Spec

### Section 15.2: Key Storage (06-security.md)

- [ ] **[MUST]** Private keys MUST be stored in:
  - Hardware secure element (preferred), OR
  - Flash with readout protection
- [ ] **[MUST]** Private key never transmitted over the air

### Section 8.5: Bootstrap and Key Derivation (06-security.md)

- [ ] **[MUST]** Private key stored securely (never transmitted)
- [ ] **[MUST]** Implementations MUST support TOFU (Trust On First Use)
- [ ] **[must]** The key must match the one that derives the observed IID/02xx address
- [ ] **[MUST]** All derived addresses (02xx, IID) MUST match key

### Section 8.6: Key Compromise and Rotation (06-security.md)

- [ ] **[SHOULD]** Nodes SHOULD support key rotation announcements
- [ ] **[MUST]** An authenticated new key creates fresh per-peer replay state; counters from the old key MUST NOT constrain the new key

### Section 8.5: BR-Provisioned Mode (06-security.md)

- [ ] **[MUST]** Channel MUST be encrypted and authenticated (for BR-provisioned)
- [ ] **[impl]** Private key deleted from BR immediately after transfer

### Section 16.7: DAO Origin Persistence (10-implementation.md)

- [ ] **[impl]** TX stores: public-key identity, last reserved Origin Sequence, complete last signed DAO bytes in crash-safe record
- [ ] **[impl]** RX stores: public key, accepted high-water sequence, digest of complete signed DAO
- [ ] **[MUST]** Implementations MUST snapshot the complete route, replay-floor, and storage state around rejected DAOs to test that no partial mutation occurs

### Summary for Python Oracle

The Python prototype needs:
1. Secure key storage abstraction (file-based with proper permissions for dev/test)
2. TOFU support for pinning keys to IID/02xx
3. Key-to-address derivation verification
4. Replay state management per peer
5. Crash-safe persistence primitives for DAO TX/RX records"}

Created checklist covering: key storage (MUST use secure element/flash, never transmit), TOFU support (MUST), key-address binding (MUST), replay state isolation on key rotation (MUST), and DAO persistence (MUST snapshot state around rejections).
